kute01.title: 1 a.m., typing to the ex
kute01.caption:
1 a.m., thumb hovering over the ex's name.
You can miss someone and still not send it.

kute02.title: Asking them to dinner, attempt nine
kute02.caption:
Nine drafts to ask one simple question?
The plain version was the brave one all along.

kute03.title: The old friend you lost touch with
kute03.caption:
A year of silence and twelve drafts of hi.
They will probably just be happy to hear from you.

kute04.title: Texting mom after the fight
kute04.caption:
That text to mom after a fight you keep rewriting.
Saying sorry first is not losing.

kute05.title: Typing "congrats" and mostly meaning it
kute05.caption:
When their good news stings a little.
You can feel envy and still send real joy.

kute06.title: Virgo's text has footnotes
kute06.caption:
Wrote a full essay to say one feeling?
Ten honest words land better than ten paragraphs.

kute07.title: "So... what are we?" draft six
kute07.caption:
Trying to ask what this is without sounding like you're asking.
Ask clearly, then listen kindly.
